name: NotifyWise – Back In Stock Notifier for WooCommerce
author: 6amtech

sections.description:
NotifyWise – Back In Stock Notifier for WooCommerce is a must-have solution for WooCommerce stores looking to automate restock alerts and improve customer retention.

It allows you to send automatic restock notifications so that customers never miss out on their favorite products.

By integrating this plugin, you keep shoppers engaged, improve user experience, and maximize revenue. With seamless automation, you can reduce lost opportunities and turn stockouts into conversions effortlessly.

This plugin integrates with external services like Brevo, SendGrid, and Google reCAPTCHA to provide email notifications, spam protection, and email marketing support. Please review their privacy policies before enabling these features.

Key Features

  • Customizable “Notify Me” Button – Adjust button text and appearance to match your store’s branding.
  • Flexible Subscription Management – Admins can enable/disable subscriptions for specific products.
  • Dynamic Email Customization – Personalize email subject and body with tags like {product_name} and {product_link}.
  • Multi-Channel Email Delivery – Choose from Manual SMTP, Brevo, or SendGrid for email notifications.
  • Brevo Marketing API Integration – Store contacts directly in your Brevo list for future marketing campaigns.
  • User-Friendly Dashboard – Manage notifications, subscribers, and settings easily from the WordPress admin panel.
  • Lightweight & Optimized – Designed for seamless performance without slowing down your site.

Benefits

  • Increase Customer Engagement – Keep shoppers connected with your store by letting them subscribe to stock alerts instead of searching elsewhere for alternatives.
  • Automate Restock Notifications – Save time with automatic WooCommerce back-in-stock emails. You won’t need to do manual follow-ups anymore.
  • Boost Repeat Purchases – With WooCommerce back in stock notifications, you encourage return visits and increase the likelihood of completing a sale.
  • Developer-Friendly Integration – Skip the hassle of creating custom notification systems. Our WooCommerce back-in-stock notifier easily integrated with your current WooCommerce setup.
  • Marketing & Growth Potential – Collect emails through stock alerts and sync them with Brevo to re-engage customers with promotions and new arrivals.
  • Customizable Email Alerts – You can customize your WooCommerce low stock notification email. This helps match your brand’s voice and gives a better shopping experience.
  • Recover Lost Sales – Don’t let stockouts cost you customers. Using this plugin you can bring them back when products are available again.
  • Improve User Experience – This notification system makes it simple for customers to get updates, leading to better satisfaction and retention rate for your WooCommerce store.

Here’s how it works:

  • “Notify Me” Button – A subscription button appears automatically on out-of-stock product pages.
  • Customer Subscription – Customers enter their email and accept GDPR content policy to receive restock alerts.
  • Automated Email Notifications – As soon as a product is back in stock, an email is sent to all subscribed customers.
  • Admin Controls – Manage subscriptions, customize email content, and choose from multiple email delivery options.
  • Brevo Marketing API Integration – Seamlessly sync customer emails for future marketing campaigns.
  • Google reCAPTCHA Integration – Create an account on Google reCAPTCHA and connect to protect your sites from fraudulent activities, spam, and abuse.

Required to configure below settings:
– Notify Button: Must configure on admin dashboard NotifyWise->Notify Button->General.
– Mailer Integration: Must configure on admin dashboard NotifyWise->Mail Configuration->Mail Integration.
– Mail Custom Content: Must configure on admin dashboard NotifyWise->Mail Configuration->Custom Content.

Documentation

NotifyWise – Back In Stock Notifier for WooCommerce comes with a detailed documentation to help you implement advanced stock notification features in your WooCommerce store. Our easy-to-follow guide helps both beginners and expert developers integrate NotifyWise without complications.

Watch the plugin in action:

External Services

This plugin integrates with trusted third-party services to enhance its functionality. Below is the list of external services used:

  1. Brevo (formerly Sendinblue)

    • Purpose: This service is used to send transactional emails and store subscribed users in a contact list for email marketing.
    • Data Sent: The plugin sends subscriber email addresses to Brevo when a user subscribes. Additionally, API requests may be made to manage contacts.
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/
    • Terms of Service: https://www.brevo.com/legal/termsofuse/

  2. SendGrid

    • Purpose: This service is used to send emails, such as order confirmations and notifications.
    • Data Sent: The plugin sends email addresses and message content to SendGrid’s API for email delivery.
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.twilio.com/legal/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://www.twilio.com/legal/tos

  3. Google reCAPTCHA

    • Purpose: Google reCAPTCHA is used to protect public forms from spam and abuse.
    • Data Sent: The plugin sends the user’s IP address and reCAPTCHA response token to Google for validation.
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard and navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Click Upload Plugin and select the notifywise-back-in-stock-notifier-for-woocommerce file.
    Click Install Now, then hit Activate once the installation is complete.
  3. Upload the notifywise-back-in-stock-notifier-for-woocommerce file.
  4. Navigate to NotifyWise from your dashboard to access the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is free to download and use.

How does the “Notify Me” button work?

The button automatically appears on out-of-stock products and product details pages. Customers can subscribe, and the plugin will notify them when the product is available.

Can I customize the email notifications?

Yes! You can modify the email subject and body in the settings panel. You can also use dynamic placeholders for a personalized touch.

What email services are supported?

You can send notifications via Manual SMTP, Brevo, or SendGrid. Configure your preferred service in the plugin settings.

Does this plugin support lead generation?

Absolutely! By integrating with Brevo Marketing API, you can automatically store subscriber data and use it for future marketing campaigns.

Is support available if I run into issues?

Yes, our expert support team is available to assist you anytime you need help.
